title: Andorra-Leganés preview: neither side arrives with injuries
text:
Andorra-Leganés preview: neither side arrives with injuries Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 🇪🇸 LaLiga 2 1d ago · November 19, 2026 Andorra-Leganés preview: neither side arrives with injuries
 FC Andorra host Leganés on Friday, 20 November, in matchday 15 of LaLiga 2, with a level head-to-head record: two wins for each side.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 19, 2026 at 01:39 PM 
 Result FC Andorra 1 – 3 Leganés Friday 20 November Goals, ratings and stats → FC Andorra host Leganés on Friday, 20 November, in matchday 15 of LaLiga 2, at the Estadi de la FAF.
 The home side is 21st with 11 points from 13 matches, and in its last five results it has one win, one draw and three defeats. Leganés is 16th with 15 points from 14 matches, with the same recent record of one win, one draw and three defeats. Neither team has any injuries on record.

 In the last five head-to-head meetings, each side has two wins and there is one draw. The most recent result, 0-4 in Leganés in April 2026, favoured Andorra, while in October 2025 Andorra lost 1-2 to Leganés.
 Our data gives Andorra 45 %, a draw 45 % and Leganés 10 %.
